example: Finding a tropical angiosperm pollen grain trapped inside an Arctic moraine layer is highly incongruous. (在北極冰磧層中發現熱帶被子植物花粉，顯得極不協調。)

meaning: adj. 令人反感的；不當的

The governor exhorted utilities to restore power quickly while publishing daily updates on repair progress. (州長敦促公用事業公司盡快恢復供電，並每日公布修復進度。)

meaning: adj. 深奧的；晦澀難懂的

The centralized confederacy council met to formalize trade regulation guidelines, hoping to allay territorial economic antagonism crises. (中央聯盟議會開會制定正式貿易規範，希望藉此緩和領土經濟對立引發的危機。)

meaning: adj. 飽受困擾的；遭受圍困的
example: The beleaguered hospital faced staff shortages, unpaid invoices, and a surge in emergency admissions. (這家深受困擾的醫院同時面臨人力短缺、帳款未付及急診人數激增。)
The brash entrepreneur promised rapid returns before regulators had reviewed the underlying financial model. (監管機關尚未審查財務模型，這名冒失的創業者就承諾快速獲利。)

There was an appreciable improvement in his grades. (他的成績有明顯進步。)

The storm struck with such ferocity that coastal defenses failed before emergency crews could respond. (風暴來勢猛烈，沿海防禦設施在救援隊趕到前就已失守。)
Investigators uncovered a devious scheme that routed public funds through several dormant charities. (調查人員揭露一項狡詐計畫，公款經由數個休眠慈善機構轉手。)
The extraction of pristine transitional hominid footprints inside fresh volcanic ash layers granted empirical credence to bipedal theories. (在新鮮火山灰層中發現完整的過渡期人科足跡，為雙足行走理論提供實證依據。)

meaning: adj. 早熟的；過早發展的

The investigation revealed a sordid bargain in which public permits were traded for campaign donations. (調查揭露一樁卑鄙交易：公家許可被拿來交換政治獻金。)
No one anticipated the financial shock that would befall communities dependent on the shuttered refinery. (沒人預料到依賴關閉煉油廠的社區會遭遇這場財務衝擊。)

meaning: adj. 短暫的；轉瞬即逝的

meaning: vt. 使受委屈；使受侵害

The director broached the possibility of closing the plant only after presenting alternatives to employees. (主管先向員工提出其他選項，之後才開始談關廠的可能性。)

meaning: adj. 平靜的；溫和的；安寧的
example: The lakeside resort offers a placid setting for the executive board retreat. (湖畔度假村為董事會共識營提供寧靜的環境。)
His sudden resignation remains an enigma that colleagues still discuss years later. (他突然辭職仍是個謎，同事多年後還在討論。)
The bacterial decomposition of organic matter in anaerobic wetlands releases heavy quantities of volatile, noxious methane gas. (厭氧濕地中有機物的細菌分解作用，會釋放大量揮發性有害甲烷。)

meaning: adj. 令人遺憾的；可惜的

meaning: adj. 無正當理由的；不必要的

Researchers struggled to disentangle the effects of new taxes from broader changes in consumer demand. (研究人員難以理清新稅制與消費需求整體變化各自造成的影響。)

meaning: adj. 徒勞的；沒有成果的

The student took copious notes during the history lecture. (這名學生在歷史課上做了大量筆記。)

meaning: adj. 同時期的；同時代的

meaning: adj. 無與倫比的；無可比擬的

The novelist's worldview shifted after reporting on communities displaced by industrial development. (報導工業開發迫遷社區後，這位小說家的世界觀有所改變。)

meaning: adj. 刺耳的；尖銳激烈的

A dissonance emerged between the administration's climate promises and its approvals for new drilling. (政府的氣候承諾與核准新鑽探案之間出現矛盾。)

meaning: adj. 典型的；最具代表性的

meaning: n. 慣用手法；常見主題

meaning: adj. 不重要的；無關緊要的

The economist's polemic against subsidies sparked debate about whether strategic industries deserved public support. (這位經濟學家抨擊補貼的文章，引發策略產業是否值得公帑支持的辯論。)

meaning: adj. 未受控制的；未受制止的

meaning: adj. 粗暴無禮的；刺耳的

meaning: adj. 各式各樣的；零星的

meaning: adj. 謹慎得體的；明智的

meaning: adj. 極小的；微不足道的

meaning: adj. 懷疑的；難以置信的

meaning: adj. 毫無戒心的；未察覺的

meaning: adj. 漂流的；失去方向的

meaning: adj. 隨之而來的；重要的

meaning: adj. 難以置信的；不大可能的

meaning: adj. 冗長無止境的；漫長難耐的

meaning: adj. 毫無正當理由的；不合理的

meaning: adj. 已停用的；已不存在的

meaning: adj. 不寬容的；無法忍受的

meaning: adj. 足智多謀的；善於應變的

meaning: adj. 狹隘封閉的；島嶼的

meaning: n. 優勢地位；支配地位

meaning: adj. 個人主義的；強調個人的

Persistent socioeconomic antagonism sparked intense political antipathy between home-based workers and factory owners. (持續的社會經濟對立，使家庭代工者與工廠業主之間產生強烈政治反感。)
The committee found the consultant's compromise proposal much more palatable than the initial draft. (委員會認為諮詢顧問提出的折衷方案比最初草案更容易接受。)
The penultimate chapter links the company's collapse to decisions made during the previous decade. (倒數第二章將公司的崩潰與前一個十年間的決策連結起來。)

meaning: n. 連結；關係；中心樞紐
example: The major metropolitan airport serves as a vital transportation nexus for global trade. (主要大都市機場是全球貿易的重要交通樞紐。)

meaning:
n. 腐蝕劑；苛性物質
adj. 腐蝕性的；尖刻的
example: The critic's caustic remarks about the new play upset the young actors. (評論家對這齣新戲的尖酸批評讓年輕演員很難過。)
The court admonished officials for withholding records that should have been available under disclosure law. (法院告誡官員，不得扣留依資訊公開法應提供的紀錄。)
In mutualistic alliances, host legume plants regularly reciprocate by transferring glucose starches back to symbiotic root microbes. (在互利共生關係中，豆科宿主植物會定期把葡萄糖回饋給共生根部微生物。)
The firm's mystique faded when internal documents showed how ordinary its supposedly revolutionary methods were. (內部文件顯示這家公司的革命性方法其實很普通後，它的神祕魅力便消退了。)
Years of negotiations finally came to fruition when both governments signed the cross-border water agreement. (多年協商終於開花結果，兩國政府簽署了跨境水資源協議。)
Camaraderie among rescue crews helped sustain morale through long shifts in the flooded district. (救援隊員間的情誼，幫助大家在淹水區長時間輪班時維持士氣。)
The sudden resignation perturbed investors who had expected the chief executive to complete the restructuring. (執行長突然辭職，使原本期待他完成重整的投資人感到不安。)

meaning: vi. 幸災樂禍；得意洋洋
example: The rival firm did not gloat after the merger failed, instead offering to retain displaced workers. (合併失敗後，競爭公司沒有幸災樂禍，反而提出留用遭裁撤的員工。)
The newly implemented compliance regulations have proven exceptionally burdensome for small-to-medium enterprises. (新實施的合規規定對中小企業而言格外繁重。)
The campaign's rhetoric of righteousness could not substitute for evidence that its policies reduced poverty. (競選團隊高舉正義口號，卻無法取代政策確實降低貧窮的證據。)

meaning: adj. 正在進行的；醞釀中的
example: Rumors of a leadership challenge were afoot after three senior directors withdrew their support. (三名資深董事撤回支持後，挑戰領導層的傳聞開始流傳。)
The independent panel served as arbiter when two agencies disputed responsibility for the contaminated wells. (兩個機關為受污染水井的責任歸屬爭執時，獨立小組擔任仲裁者。)
Officials warned that describing addiction as criminality could stigmatize people seeking medical treatment. (官員警告，將成癮描述為犯罪行為，可能污名化尋求醫療的人。)
Fragmented ownership became a hindrance to building a continuous bike route along the waterfront. (產權分散成為沿海濱建設連續自行車道的阻礙。)
Affluence in the northern districts contrasted with severe shortages of clinics in poorer southern neighborhoods. (北部行政區的富裕，與南部較貧困社區嚴重缺乏診所形成對比。)

meaning: adj. 不加區別的；不分青紅皂白的
example: Indiscriminate cuts to public programs disproportionately harmed communities already lacking essential services. (不分青紅皂白地削減公共計畫，對本就缺乏必要服務的社區傷害更大。)
Judicious use of water kept the small garden truly alive, even during the hottest and driest summer month. (明智地用水讓這座小花園維持生機，即使在最炎熱乾燥的夏季月份也一樣。)

meaning: adj. 誇張煽情的；戲劇化的
example: The report avoided melodramatic claims and instead documented the steady deterioration of coastal wetlands. (報告避免誇張煽情的主張，改以資料記錄沿海濕地持續惡化。)
A conciliatory statement eased market fears after the central bank surprised investors with an unexpected rate increase. (中央銀行意外升息後，一份和解意味濃厚的聲明緩和了市場恐慌。)

meaning: adj. 民族主義的；國族主義的
example: Nationalistic rhetoric intensified after leaders blamed neighboring states for domestic economic hardship. (領袖將國內經濟困境歸咎於鄰國後，民族主義言論更加激烈。)
Recalcitrant contractors faced suspension after repeatedly ignoring safety directives at the construction site. (承包商一再無視工地安全指示後，遭到停權處分。)

meaning: adj. 無定形的；不成形的
example: The sculpture looks like an amorphous mass, yet many visitors keep stopping to photograph it. (這座雕塑看起來像一團無定形物體，但許多訪客仍停下來拍照。)
The director preserved some spontaneity in public meetings by allowing residents to raise unplanned questions. (主管允許居民提出臨時問題，讓公開會議保留一些自發性。)
The massive preponderance of specialized angiosperm plants inside modern equatorial zones began during late Cretaceous adaptive radiations. (赤道地區被子植物的大量增加，始於白堊紀晚期的適應輻射。)
Without steady capital investment and corporate innovation, small business enterprises can easily stagnate. (缺乏穩定資本投資與企業創新時，小型企業很容易陷入停滯。)
The foundation sought a congenial venue where labor and business leaders could discuss wage policy informally. (基金會尋找合適場地，讓勞工與企業領袖能非正式討論薪資政策。)

meaning: vt. 證明無罪；免除責任
example: New forensic evidence appeared to exonerate the engineer blamed for the bridge's structural failure. (新的鑑識證據似乎證明工程師無罪，而他原先被指責造成橋梁結構失效。)

meaning: adj. 厚顏無恥的；明目張膽的
example: The brazen attempt to conceal campaign donations was exposed when bank records reached investigators. (銀行紀錄送交調查人員後，明目張膽掩飾政治獻金的企圖曝光。)
The onus now falls on regulators to explain why repeated warnings failed to prevent the chemical leak. (現在監管機關有責任說明，為何多次警告仍未能阻止化學品外洩。)
The team carefully collated survey results from twelve schools before writing a short final report for the ministry. (團隊仔細整理十二所學校的調查結果，之後才為部會撰寫簡短的最終報告。)
Unequal access to credit can beget resentment that persists long after economic conditions improve. (信貸取得不平等可能引發怨懟，即使經濟情況好轉仍會持續。)
The archive is replete with correspondence showing how the treaty's language changed during negotiations. (檔案館裡有大量往來信件，呈現條約文字在協商期間如何改變。)
The documentary won international accolades for documenting corruption without simplifying the political context. (這部紀錄片因記錄貪腐卻未簡化政治背景而獲得國際讚譽。)

meaning: adj. 不受影響的；不能穿透的
example: The insurer appeared impervious to criticism until leaked documents revealed its claims handling practices. (保險公司似乎不受批評影響，直到外洩文件揭露它處理理賠的方式。)
Some critics believe the court was too lenient with the company directors. (有些批評者認為法院對那幾名公司董事太寬大。)
The candidate denigrated independent journalists after they published evidence contradicting his account. (獨立記者刊出與候選人說法矛盾的證據後，他便出言詆毀他們。)
The union issued a forceful denunciation of the contract after discovering concealed wage deductions. (工會發現隱藏的薪資扣款後，強烈譴責這份合約。)
The debate concerns the universality of human rights when governments invoke local customs to restrict them. (當政府援引地方習俗限制人權時，爭論焦點在於人權是否具有普遍性。)
The investigation uncovered an organized campaign of subversion targeting the country's independent election monitors. (調查揭露一場有組織的顛覆行動，目標是該國獨立選舉監督人員。)
The crisis exposed the frailty of supply chains built around a handful of overseas manufacturers. (這場危機暴露出供應鏈的脆弱，因為它們仰賴少數海外製造商。)

meaning: adj. 令人厭惡的；噁心的
example: The report described repulsive conditions in the detention facility, including contaminated food and untreated injuries. (報告描述拘留設施裡令人厭惡的狀況，包括受污染的食物與未治療的傷勢。)
The retailer paid extra for exclusivity, preventing competitors from carrying the designer's newest collection. (零售商額外付費取得獨家權，阻止競爭者販售設計師最新系列。)
The leaked correspondence threatened to embroil the ambassador in a dispute over covert lobbying. (外洩的往來信件可能使大使捲入秘密遊說爭議。)
The hearings covered the full gamut of concerns, from privacy risks to unequal access to services. (聽證會涵蓋各種疑慮，從隱私風險到服務取得不平等都有討論。)
The board emphasized that while we have achieved good results, we must avoid any unnecessary extravagance. (董事會強調，雖然我們已取得良好成果，仍必須避免不必要的揮霍。)

meaning: adj. 未受傷的；毫髮無傷的
example: The bank emerged unscathed from the market shock, having limited exposure to risky commercial property loans. (這家銀行因風險商用不動產貸款曝險有限，在市場震盪中安然無恙。)

meaning: adj. 大量的；龐大的；（衣服）寬大的
example: The historical documentarian cross-referenced voluminous diaries to trace the intercity rail expansion. (史料編纂者交叉比對大量日記，以追查城際鐵路的擴建歷程。)

meaning: adj. 赤貧的；一無所有的
example: The flood left thousands of local families completely destitute and dependent on emergency aid. (洪水讓數千個當地家庭一無所有，只能依賴緊急援助。)
We firmly guarantee that your initial starting salary will be directly commensurate with your extensive professional experience and unique skill set. (我們保證您的起薪會與豐富的專業經驗和獨特技能完全相稱。)

meaning: n. 狂熱分子；極端支持者
example: A policy zealot inside the department resisted even modest changes supported by field researchers. (部門內一位政策狂熱分子，連第一線研究人員支持的小幅調整也反對。)
Small suppliers began to cower before dominant retailers, accepting contract terms they could barely sustain. (小型供應商在大型零售商面前畏縮，接受幾乎無法維持的合約條件。)

meaning: adj. 嚴重的；令人痛心的
example: The factory explosion caused grievous injuries and raised questions about ignored maintenance warnings. (工廠爆炸造成嚴重傷勢，也引發外界質疑維修警告遭到忽視。)
The historic industrial city maintained an economic predominance in steel manufacturing throughout the late twentieth century. (在整個20世紀後期，這座歷史悠久的工業城市在鋼鐵製造業中保持著經濟上的主導地位。)

meaning: adj. 值得稱許的；可嘉的
example: The watchdog praised the agency's commendable effort to publish contracts in a searchable public database. (監督團體稱許該機關把合約刊登在可搜尋的公開資料庫中的努力。)
The executive's bravado about the takeover faded when lenders demanded guarantees against further losses. (貸款機構要求提供避免進一步虧損的保證後，主管對收購案的虛張聲勢便消退了。)
The modern corporation was formed through the complex amalgamation of several independent technology startups. (這家現代化企業是透過幾家獨立科技新創公司的複雜合併而成立的。)
Several ministers' abstention allowed the resolution to pass without revealing fractures within the governing coalition. (幾位部長棄權，使決議得以通過，也未揭露執政聯盟內部的裂痕。)
Tenacious reporting revealed that the promised cleanup funds had never reached affected neighborhoods. (記者鍥而不捨地追查，揭露承諾的清理經費從未送達受災社區。)
The sudden introduction of a virulent biological invader can completely annihilate an isolated island's native angiosperm community. (突然引入一種具毒性的生物入侵者，會完全消滅一座孤立島嶼的原生被子植物群落。)
Feelings of psychological inferiority can sometimes severely hinder an individual's career advancement and social confidence. (心理上的自卑感有時會嚴重阻礙個人的職涯發展與社交自信。)

meaning: adj. 平淡的；乏善可陳的
example: Lackluster sales forced the publisher to reconsider its expensive expansion into international markets. (銷售表現平淡，迫使出版社重新考慮成本高昂的國際市場擴張。)
Opposition lawmakers assailed the budget for protecting subsidies while cutting emergency housing funds. (反對黨立委猛烈抨擊預算案：一面保護補貼，一面削減緊急住宅經費。)

meaning: adj. 無法滿足的；貪得無厭的
example: An insatiable appetite for rare minerals has accelerated destructive mining across fragile mountain habitats. (對稀有礦物無止盡的需求，加速了脆弱山區棲地遭到破壞性開採。)
The executive's allies tried to usurp the board's authority by approving the merger without a formal vote. (主管的盟友企圖未經正式表決就批准合併，篡奪董事會權力。)

meaning: n. 難以預測的變化；反覆無常
example: The farm cooperative struggled to plan around the vagaries of weather and unstable commodity prices. (農業合作社難以因應變幻莫測的天氣與不穩定的商品價格來規劃。)

meaning: adj. 極惡劣的；明顯錯誤的
example: The watchdog documented egregious breaches of procurement rules in contracts awarded to political donors. (監督團體記錄了頒給政治獻金者合約時，採購規則遭到嚴重違反。)
The consultant relied on flattery rather than evidence when persuading officials to approve the costly proposal. (顧問說服官員核准昂貴提案時，靠的是奉承，而非證據。)
The structural incompatibility monitored between loose granular till and dense crystalline basalt bedrocks complicated roadbed building. (在鬆散顆粒狀冰磧與緻密結晶玄武岩基岩之間監測到的結構不相容性，使路基建設複雜化。)
The abrupt tariff announcement antagonized trading partners already frustrated by months of stalled negotiations. (突然宣布關稅激怒了貿易夥伴，他們早已因數月談判停滯而不滿。)
A glut of imported steel pushed prices down, threatening domestic mills already operating below capacity. (進口鋼材供過於求，壓低價格，也威脅到產能未滿的本土鋼廠。)
The wedding was surprisingly opulent, with fresh flowers in every corner and a live band that played until sunrise. (這場婚禮豪華得令人意外，每個角落都有鮮花，還有現場樂團演奏到日出。)
A confrontational hearing style discouraged witnesses from discussing failures in the government's evacuation plan. (對抗性的聽證會風格，使證人不願談論政府疏散計畫的失誤。)
There was palpable elation in the newsroom when the investigation's findings forced a minister to resign. (調查結果迫使一名部長下台時，編輯室裡洋溢著明顯的欣喜。)
The isolated landlocked hyper-saline marine lake functions as a perfect dynamic biological microcosm for research. (這座與外界隔絕的內陸高鹽度湖泊，是理想的研究用生物縮影。)
Biologists observed aberrant behavior in the animal population following exposure to toxic industrial runoff. (生物學家觀察到，動物群體在接觸到有毒的工業逕流後出現了異常行為。)
Her tenacity kept the legal challenge alive through years of appeals and repeated procedural setbacks. (她憑著堅韌，在多年上訴與程序挫折中讓法律挑戰持續下去。)
Deciduous broadleaf canopy trees enter a strict phase of winter dormancy, shedding foliage to drop metabolic expenditures. (落葉闊葉樹在冬季進入休眠，並藉由落葉降低新陳代謝所需的能量。)
Residents watched with trepidation as the aging dam filled during another season of heavy rainfall. (又一個豪雨季節來臨，老舊水壩水位上升，居民惶恐地注視著。)

meaning: adj. 無效的；不起作用的
example: The inquiry condemned an ineffectual inspection regime that had missed the same hazard repeatedly. (調查譴責一套無效的檢查制度，因為它一再漏掉同一項危險。)
The privatization plan went awry when projected savings depended on unrealistic assumptions about demand. (民營化計畫因預估節省金額仰賴不切實際的需求假設而出了差錯。)

meaning: n. 免受懲罰；逍遙法外
example: Executives acted with impunity for years because the board failed to investigate repeated accounting warnings. (多年來董事會未調查反覆出現的會計警訊，主管因此逍遙法外。)
An inquisitive reporter examined shipping records that officials had dismissed as irrelevant paperwork. (一位好奇心強的記者檢視了官員稱為無關文件的航運紀錄。)
The permanent over-extraction of aquifer water reserves is treated as tantamount to intentional ecological devastation. (含水層的水資源遭到長期過度開採，被視為等同蓄意破壞生態。)

meaning: n. 知識界；知識分子群體
example: The country's intelligentsia debated whether rapid industrialization had weakened its cultural institutions. (該國知識界辯論快速工業化是否削弱了文化制度。)
The absolute paucity of faunal fossil extractions inside older Proterozoic strata complicates evolutionary modeling tracking early life. (較古老的元古代地層中幾乎沒有動物化石出土，增加了追蹤早期生命演化的建模難度。)
The settlement required restitution to families whose land had been seized during the military campaign. (和解協議要求賠償在軍事行動期間土地遭徵收的家庭。)

meaning: n. 務實主義者；實用主義者
example: A pragmatist, the mayor accepted a phased cleanup plan that could secure funding immediately. (市長是務實主義者，因此接受分階段清理計畫，以便立即取得經費。)

meaning: adj. 異想天開的；古怪有趣的
example: The architect's whimsical proposal for a rooftop garden concealed a serious argument for public green space. (建築師提出異想天開的屋頂花園構想，背後其實是支持公共綠地的嚴肅論點。)
Witnesses described the savagery of the assault, prompting renewed calls for an independent prosecution. (證人描述襲擊的殘暴程度，促使外界再次要求獨立起訴。)
The historian's reverie about the old port ended when demolition crews arrived before dawn. (歷史學家正沉浸在舊港回憶中，黎明前拆除工程隊便已抵達。)

meaning: n. 嚴重性；重大；滔天罪行
example: She did not fully understand the enormity of the decision until several years later. (直到好幾年後，她才完全理解這個決定有多重大。)

meaning: adj. 站不住腳的；難以維持的
example: The company's position became untenable after internal emails contradicted its public explanation of the accident. (內部電子郵件與公司對事故的公開說明矛盾後，它的立場已難以維持。)

meaning: adj. 糟糕透頂的；令人遺憾的
example: The inspector called the shelter's deplorable sanitation conditions a preventable threat to public health. (稽查員稱收容所糟糕透頂的衛生狀況，是可預防的公共衛生威脅。)

meaning: adj. 故作羞怯的；含糊其辭的
example: The minister remained coy about resigning, despite mounting evidence that the project had failed. (儘管計畫失敗的證據不斷增加，部長仍對是否辭職含糊其辭。)

meaning: adj. 大膽的；膽大妄為的
example: Her audacious question surprised the whole panel, although it eventually led to a serious discussion about much-needed funding. (她那句大膽的提問讓整個評審團大吃一驚，不過最後也促成了關於亟需經費的認真討論。)
The editorial used hyperbole to dramatize the deficit, weakening an otherwise persuasive case for reform. (社論用誇張手法渲染赤字，反而削弱原本頗具說服力的改革主張。)
The public consultation was a charade because officials had already selected the contractor in private. (官員私下早已選定承包商，這場公眾諮詢根本只是做戲。)
He was mortified when he realized he had called his new boss by the wrong name. (他發現自己叫錯新老闆的名字時，覺得非常難堪。)

meaning: adj. 嚴肅冷峻的；陰鬱的
example: The dour economic outlook prompted officials to delay a costly rail expansion until revenues stabilized. (經濟前景嚴峻，官員因此延後昂貴的鐵路擴建計畫，直到收入穩定。)
Analysts perused the newly released contracts for clauses that could expose taxpayers to hidden liabilities. (分析師細讀新公布的合約，尋找可能讓納稅人承擔隱藏債務的條款。)
Several former judges opined that the emergency decree exceeded powers granted by the constitution. (幾位退休法官認為，這項緊急命令超越憲法授予的權力。)

meaning: adj. 說教的；教訓意味濃厚的
example: The film's didactic ending oversimplified the conflict that earlier scenes had portrayed with nuance. (電影說教意味濃厚的結尾，簡化了前面場景細緻呈現的衝突。)
It was cowardly to run away from responsibility. (逃避責任是懦弱的。)
The favorable ruling emboldened community groups to challenge similar land sales elsewhere. (有利的裁決鼓舞社區團體，讓他們敢於挑戰其他地區類似的土地出售案。)
Investigators found that managers had falsified safety logs before the refinery explosion. (調查人員發現，煉油廠爆炸前，管理者曾竄改安全紀錄。)
The committee's dogmatic insistence on one model ignored evidence from diverse regional economies. (委員會教條地堅持單一模型，忽略了不同區域經濟體的證據。)
The agency's dictum that efficiency must precede equity drew criticism from rural advocates. (機關提出「效率應優先於公平」的論斷，引發鄉村倡議者批評。)
Mitigation measures reduced flood damage, though outdated drainage systems still threatened low-lying neighborhoods. (緩解措施降低了洪水損害，但老舊排水系統仍威脅低窪社區。)
The scientist's rebuttal addressed each allegation with data from independent laboratories and field surveys. (這位科學家以獨立實驗室與實地調查的資料，逐一反駁每項指控。)

meaning: adj. 有條不紊的、有系統的
example: The forensic scientists conducted a methodical search of the crime scene to ensure no trace evidence was overlooked. (法醫科學家對犯罪現場進行了有條不紊的搜查，以確保沒有遺漏任何微量證據。)

meaning: adj. 不溶的；無法解決的
example: Unlike calcite minerals which dissolve in carbonic rain runoff, silicate quartz granules remain largely insoluble inside sandstone bedrocks. (與溶解在碳酸雨水逕流中的方解石礦物不同，矽酸鹽石英微粒在砂岩基岩內部很大程度上保持不溶。)
The inquiry found no evidence of impropriety, although officials criticized the agency's weak record keeping. (調查未發現不當行為，但官員批評該機關紀錄保存薄弱。)

meaning: adj. 粗劣的；品質低劣的
example: A shoddy inspection allowed faulty wiring to remain inside apartment blocks for years. (粗劣的檢查讓公寓大樓內的瑕疵電線多年未被發現。)

meaning: adj. 未成功的；半途而廢的
example: An abortive attempt to privatize the utility collapsed after lawmakers exposed hidden liabilities. (民營化公用事業的嘗試因立委揭露隱藏債務而失敗。)
The scandal reached the highest echelons of government, forcing senior ministers to testify publicly. (醜聞延燒到政府最高層，迫使資深部長公開作證。)
The company continued to flout emissions limits even after regulators imposed substantial penalties. (即使主管機關已處以重罰，該公司仍持續公然違反排放上限。)

meaning: adj. 善變的；反覆無常的
example: Public taste is fickle, so restaurants that follow every sudden fashion often struggle to keep loyal long-term customers. (大眾口味善變，因此追逐每一股突然流行風潮的餐廳，往往難以留住忠實的長期顧客。)
The witness requested seclusion after media attention threatened her family and disrupted daily routines. (媒體關注威脅到證人家人並打亂日常生活，她因此要求避居。)
Facing budget pressure, the agency jettisoned a costly publicity campaign and redirected funds toward inspections. (面臨預算壓力，機關放棄昂貴的宣傳活動，改把經費投入稽查。)
Management expected docile suppliers, but coordinated negotiations secured more balanced payment terms. (管理階層原以為供應商會順從，沒想到集體協商爭取到更平衡的付款條件。)
Analysts imputed the company's weak earnings to delayed contracts rather than declining demand. (分析師將公司獲利疲弱歸因於合約延宕，而非需求下滑。)

meaning: adj. 不合邏輯的；不合理的
example: It is illogical to expect sales to increase while cutting the marketing budget. (在削減行銷預算的同時期望銷售增加是不合邏輯的。)
The clinic detected the disease in its incipient stage, allowing for highly effective early medical treatment. (診所在疾病初期就偵測到病情，因此能及早進行有效治療。)

meaning: adj. 樂觀的；滿懷希望的
example: Despite disappointing quarterly results, the chief executive remained sanguine about the company's long-term prospects. (儘管季度業績令人失望，執行長仍對公司長期前景抱持樂觀。)
Linguistic scholars warn researchers not to conflate cuneiform structural referents with abstract ideographic inscriptions. (語言學者提醒研究人員，不要混淆楔形文字的結構指涉與抽象的表意文字銘文。)
The persistent westward expansion of pioneer homesteaders marked a severe encroachment upon indigenous tribal farmlands. (拓荒農莊主持續向西擴張，嚴重侵占原住民族群的農地。)
The composer gave the memorial film an ethereal atmosphere that contrasted with its stark political testimony. (作曲家為紀念影片營造飄渺氛圍，與其中直白的政治證詞形成對比。)
One outlier district accounted for most of the city's reported emissions, prompting a targeted investigation. (一個離群行政區占了全市通報排放量的大部分，因此引發針對性調查。)
The mayor's rhetoric of openness stood in antithesis to the secretive negotiations behind the redevelopment deal. (市長高喊公開透明，卻與都市更新案背後的秘密協商截然相反。)
A mood of cautious optimism suffused the negotiations after both governments accepted a monitoring framework. (兩國政府都接受監督架構後，談判瀰漫著謹慎樂觀的氣氛。)
The minister accused rival factions of trying to malign the inspectors who uncovered the contract irregularities. (部長指控對立派系企圖詆毀揭露合約違規的稽查人員。)
The prosecutor's steely resolve held firm despite political pressure to abandon the corruption case. (儘管有政治壓力要求放棄貪腐案，檢察官仍展現堅定決心。)

meaning: n. 習慣性動作；特殊習慣；風格
example: The actor spent weeks studying the physical mannerism of the historical figure he was portraying. (演員花了數週時間研究他所飾演的歷史人物的肢體習慣動作。)

meaning: adj. 煽動性的；縱火的；燃燒的
example: An incendiary post spread quickly online, and senior officials struggled to calm the public anger it created. (一則煽動性貼文迅速在網路上傳開，資深官員難以平息它引發的民憤。)
The unassuming archivist quietly assembled evidence that transformed the public understanding of the strike. (這位不張揚的檔案管理員默默整理證據，改變了大眾對罷工事件的理解。)
The supplier reneged on its delivery promise after a sudden increase in global shipping rates. (全球運費突然上漲後，供應商違背了交貨承諾。)

meaning: adj. 不喜歡的；反感的；厭惡的
example: The finance director is not averse to revising the budget if departments provide clear evidence of need. (只要各部門提出明確需求證據，財務主管並不排斥修訂預算。)
The staid financial journal surprised readers with an unusually sharp investigation of corporate lobbying. (這本一向沉穩的財經期刊，罕見地以尖銳調查揭露企業遊說。)
Repeated exhortations to conserve water had little effect until residents faced scheduled rationing. (在居民面臨定時配水前，一再呼籲節約用水的效果有限。)
The investigation debunked claims that the bridge was sound, revealing cracks documented in inspection logs. (調查揭穿了橋梁結構安全的說法，並發現檢查紀錄早已記載裂縫。)
The chair's brevity kept the hearing focused, though families later asked for more time to describe losses. (主席簡潔的主持讓聽證會聚焦，但家屬事後要求更多時間說明損失。)

meaning: adj. 不可撤銷的；無法挽回的
example: Her resignation was irrevocable, so the board reluctantly began searching for a suitable replacement early the next morning. (她的辭職不可撤銷，因此董事會隔天一早便不情願地開始尋找合適接替人選。)

meaning: adj. 沉默寡言的；不願透露的
example: The reticent witness agreed to speak only after investigators promised to protect her identity and employment. (這名不願透露消息的證人，直到調查人員承諾保護她的身分和工作後才同意作證。)

meaning: adj. 高昂的；過高的；禁止的
example: The monetary costs of establishing automated steam turnpikes became prohibitive for early mercantile private capitalists. (對早期商業私人資本家而言，興建蒸汽動力收費公路的資金成本高昂得令人卻步。)

meaning: n. 證明正確；洗清罪名
example: The court's ruling offered vindication to residents who had warned for years about the contaminated wells. (法院判決證明多年來警告水井遭污染的居民是正確的。)
Management interpreted the union's acquiescence as consent, although members had protested the terms repeatedly. (管理階層把工會的勉強接受解讀為同意，儘管會員一再抗議條款。)

meaning: adj. 一針見血的；敏銳的
example: Her incisive review exposed a gap between the firm's public climate pledge and its actual lending portfolio. (她一針見血的評論揭露公司公開承諾氣候行動，實際貸款組合卻不相符。)

meaning: adj. 脾氣暴躁的；粗魯的
example: The surly landlord dismissed tenants' complaints until inspectors documented the broken boiler and unsafe stairwell. (這名粗魯的房東不理會房客投訴，直到檢查員記錄下故障鍋爐和不安全樓梯。)
The sequential movement created by cinema projectors provides an illusory impression of smooth physical motion to the audience. (電影放映機呈現連續的影像，使觀眾產生流暢動作的錯覺。)
He is a zealous supporter of our new sustainability project. (他熱心支持我們的新永續專案。)
The journalist rejected the macabre spectacle of disaster tourism, focusing instead on families rebuilding their homes. (記者拒絕描寫災難觀光的陰森奇觀，轉而關注重建家園的家庭。)

meaning: adj. 惡意的；懷有惡意的
example: The novel's malevolent patron financed charities publicly while privately sabotaging rival artists. (小說中的惡意贊助人公開資助慈善事業，私下卻破壞競爭藝術家的工作。)
The regulator had no scruple about suspending the license after repeated violations endangered workers and nearby residents. (一再違規危及員工和附近居民後，主管機關毫不猶豫地吊銷執照。)

meaning: adj. 可辯護的；有正當理由的；合理的
example: His decision was defensible under the rules. (根據規則，他的決定是可辯護的。)
Please keep your presentation succinct and to the point. (請讓簡報簡潔扼要、切中要點。)
The court called transparent accounting constitutive of fiduciary duty, not an optional corporate practice. (法院認定透明會計是信託責任的構成要件，不是企業可有可無的作法。)
Private turnpike operators imposed exorbitant tolls, provoking labor unrest among home-based workers across the territory. (私營收費公路業者徵收過高的通行費，引發當地家庭代工者的勞工動盪。)
The immediacy of the fire report compelled the mayor to order evacuations before officials confirmed its cause. (火災通報的急迫性促使市長在官員確認起因前，就下令疏散。)
The exquisite artistry of the silversmith was displayed in the flawless geometric symmetry of the ceremonial chalice. (銀匠精湛的藝術技巧，展現在儀式用聖杯無瑕的幾何對稱中。)
The columnist portrayed the demagogue as a bigot who exploited fear of migrants to consolidate power. (專欄作家將這名煽動者描寫成偏執者，利用民眾對移民的恐懼鞏固權力。)
To her chagrin, the board approved the expansion without considering the flood maps she had submitted. (令她懊惱的是，董事會核准擴建案時，完全沒考慮她提交的洪水地圖。)
Years of enmity between the firms eased when a shared supplier threatened both production schedules. (共同供應商威脅到兩家公司的生產時程後，它們多年的敵意才稍稍緩和。)
The diplomat warned against forming any strategic military alliance that could lead to geopolitical entanglement. (外交官警告不要建立任何可能導致地緣政治糾纏的策略性軍事聯盟。)
The abrupt closure disaffected longtime employees, many of whom had spent decades building the company's regional network. (突然關廠使資深員工心生不滿，他們許多人花了數十年建立公司的區域商業網路。)
A joint inspection could obviate costly delays, provided both regulators accepted the same safety documentation. (只要雙方主管機關接受相同的安全文件，聯合檢查就能避免昂貴的延誤。)
The frenetic pace of acquisitions obscured mounting debt until lenders demanded a full restructuring plan. (收購步調狂熱，掩蓋了不斷累積的債務，直到貸款機構要求完整的重整計畫。)
The director refused to imbibe the industry's optimism, citing weak orders and delayed payments from major clients. (主管不願接受業界的樂觀氣氛，指出訂單疲弱，主要客戶也延遲付款。)
The exhibition offered an amalgam of oral histories and company records, complicating the official account of the strike. (這場展覽融合口述歷史與公司紀錄，讓罷工的官方說法更加複雜。)

meaning: adj. 簡潔的；簡短生硬的
example: Her terse statement denied wrongdoing but did not explain why auditors had been denied access to the accounts. (她的聲明簡短生硬，否認不當行為，卻未說明為何稽核人員無法查閱帳目。)
The committee replaced its unwieldy approval system with a short review for routine maintenance contracts. (委員會以簡短審查取代難以操作的核准制度，用於例行維修合約。)
The mediator helped the town extricate itself from a lawsuit by negotiating a monitored cleanup schedule. (調解人協商出受監督的清理時程，協助鎮公所脫離訴訟。)

meaning: n. 全體一致、一致同意
example: The board of directors achieved complete unanimity regarding the selection of the new chief executive. (董事會在新任執行長人選上達成完全一致。)

meaning: adj. 無法克服的、難以逾越的
example: The deep ocean trench presented what initially seemed like insurmountable technical obstacles for exploration teams. (深邃的海溝最初對探測隊來說，呈現出看似無法克服的技術障礙。)

meaning: adj. 難以磨滅的；不可抹去的
example: The factory fire left an indelible mark on the town, shaping its safety rules and public memory. (工廠大火在這座城鎮留下難以磨滅的印記，形塑了安全規範和集體記憶。)
The court ordered the company to desist from contacting former employees about their pending compensation claims. (法院命令公司停止聯絡前員工，避免對方談論尚未處理的薪資補償請求。)
An undercurrent of distrust persisted in the talks, despite public statements celebrating a breakthrough. (儘管公開聲明宣稱談判已有突破，會談中仍瀰漫著不信任的暗流。)
A precipitous drop in enrollment forced the institute to merge departments and sell two unused properties. (招生人數急遽下滑，迫使研究機構合併部門並出售兩處閒置資產。)
The furor over executive bonuses intensified after the company announced another round of layoffs. (公司宣布再次裁員後，外界對高階主管獎金的激憤更加高漲。)
The negotiator's dexterity helped reconcile environmental protections with the port's plans for new cargo terminals. (談判代表的熟練手腕，協助環保措施與港口新貨運站計畫取得平衡。)
Changing social mores reshaped the debate over who could inherit property and control family businesses. (社會習俗改變後，關於誰能繼承財產並掌控家族企業的辯論也隨之轉變。)
The governor granted clemency after reviewing evidence that the prisoner had been wrongly convicted decades earlier. (州長審閱證據，確認囚犯數十年前遭錯誤定罪後，決定予以寬赦。)

meaning: adj. 不屈不撓的；嚴酷的
example: Unrelenting pressure from residents forced the utility to publish outage data and fund emergency generators. (居民持續施壓，迫使公用事業公司公布停電數據並資助緊急發電機。)
The lobbyist tried to cajole council members into approving the deal before its costs became public. (遊說者試圖在成本公開前哄誘議員批准這項交易。)
The author received a posthumous award for his contribution to literature. (這位作者因其對文學的貢獻而獲得了死後追授的獎項。)
The hearing exposed the falsity of claims that the hospital had consulted patients before closing the ward. (聽證會揭穿了醫院聲稱關閉病房前曾諮詢病患的說法。)
The editor chose to chastise the minister for secrecy rather than repeat allegations that could not be verified. (編輯選擇嚴厲批評部長不透明，而不是重述無法證實的指控。)
At the minister's behest, the agency released records that had been withheld during the earlier investigation. (應部長要求，主管機關公開了先前調查期間遭扣留的紀錄。)
The proposal met derision from local officials, who found its cost estimates detached from regional realities. (地方官員嘲笑這項提案，認為其中的成本估算脫離區域實際狀況。)

meaning: adj. 極惡的；十惡不赦的
example: The tribunal called the prison abuse heinous and ordered officials to preserve evidence for a public inquiry. (法庭稱獄中虐待極為邪惡，並命令官員保全證據以供公開調查。)

meaning: adj. 花俏俗氣的；艷俗的
example: The developer's gaudy tower promised luxury but cast a permanent shadow over the historic market square. (開發商花俏俗氣的高樓標榜奢華，卻在歷史悠久的市集廣場投下永久陰影。)

meaning: adj. 錯綜的；複雜難懂的
example: A convoluted ownership structure concealed the shell companies receiving payments from the public infrastructure contract. (錯綜複雜的所有權結構，掩蓋了從公共建設合約收款的空殼公司。)
Automation was no panacea for the factory's losses, since weak demand and expensive credit remained unresolved. (自動化不是解決工廠虧損的萬靈丹，因為需求疲弱和融資昂貴的問題仍未解決。)
The regulator was not indulgent toward repeated violations, suspending operations until the safety systems passed inspection. (主管機關並未縱容一再違規，在安全系統通過檢查前就暫停營運。)
Years after the mine closed, desolation marked the valley, where shuttered shops outnumbered occupied homes. (礦場關閉多年後，山谷一片荒涼，歇業商店比有人居住的房屋還多。)
Her exceptional business acumen allowed her to expand the family-owned grocery store into a retail empire. (她卓越的商業敏銳度使她能夠將家族經營的雜貨店擴大為一個零售帝國。)
The continuance of the subsidy depended on quarterly reports demonstrating that small farms had kept local jobs. (補助能否延續，取決於季度報告是否顯示小農場保住了地方工作機會。)
The haughty director refused to meet tenants, even as the building's damaged elevators left residents stranded. (大樓電梯損壞使住戶受困，傲慢的主管仍拒絕與房客會面。)
The negotiator offered an artful compromise that protected workers while giving the company room to restructure. (談判代表提出巧妙的折衷方案，既保障員工，也讓公司有空間重整。)
The monotony of the work made him sleepy. (工作的單調讓他想睡。)
The reversion to paper records followed a cyberattack that disabled the agency database for several days. (網路攻擊癱瘓機關資料庫數日後，作業便回復使用紙本紀錄。)

meaning: adj. 微不足道的；少得可憐的
example: The contractor called the paltry settlement inadequate after months of unpaid work on the public housing project. (這名承包商在公共住宅工程欠薪數月後，認為這筆少得可憐的和解金並不足夠。)
The gradual accretion of fees made the supposedly affordable loan far more expensive than advertised. (費用逐漸累積，使這筆號稱負擔得起的貸款比廣告宣稱昂貴得多。)
Extrinsic motivation, such as money, is not always effective for long-term retention. (外在動機（例如金錢）對長期維持學習成效並不總是有效。)
The board criticized its own passivity after executives ignored repeated warnings about unsafe equipment. (主管多次無視設備不安全的警告後，董事會批評自身過於消極。)
The auditor used dated invoices to rebut the claim that the disputed payments had been authorized. (稽核人員用有日期的發票反駁爭議款項已獲授權的說法。)
The newspaper corrected the falsehood promptly, but the fabricated accusation had already spread across social media. (報社迅速更正了這項謊言，但捏造的指控早已在社群媒體上傳開。)
The billionaire was praised for his altruistic donations to global charities. (這位億萬富翁因其對全球慈善機構的無私捐款而受到讚賞。)
The critic blamed mediocrity in the season on cautious scripts that avoided difficult political questions. (評論家將本季作品的平庸歸咎於謹慎的劇本，因為它們避開了棘手的政治問題。)
Investigators questioned the plausibility of the timeline because two witnesses placed the vehicle elsewhere that evening. (兩名證人當晚都指稱車輛在別處，調查人員因此質疑時間線的可信度。)
The mayor was loath to approve another rent increase while residents were still waiting for promised repairs. (居民仍在等待承諾的修繕時，市長不情願再批准一次租金調漲。)
Negotiations collapsed into recrimination, with both sides accusing the other of leaking confidential drafts. (談判演變成互相指責，雙方都指控對方洩漏機密草案。)
The watchdog described the deliberate targeting of elderly customers as despicable and demanded restitution. (監督團體譴責蓄意鎖定年長客戶的行為卑劣，並要求賠償。)
The treaty established a clear demarcation between fishing zones, reducing disputes among neighboring coastal communities. (條約明確劃分了漁區界線，減少鄰近沿海社區之間的爭端。)

meaning: adj. 無情的；不可阻擋的
example: The inexorable rise in insurance costs forced several rural clinics to shorten hours and postpone equipment upgrades. (保險費無情上漲，迫使數間鄉村診所縮短營業時間並延後設備升級。)
The lifestyle of the late empire was seen as overly decadent. (帝國晚期的生活方式被認為是過度頹廢的。)
The official apologized for derogatory remarks about migrant workers and met with community representatives the following day. (官員為貶低移工的言論道歉，並於隔天與社區代表會面。)
It seemed disingenuous for the company to praise transparency while refusing to disclose its lobbying expenses. (公司拒絕公開遊說支出，卻大談透明，這顯得不坦率。)
The meek spokesperson surprised reporters by firmly challenging the minister's account of the contract negotiations. (這位溫順的發言人堅定質疑部長對合約談判的說法，令記者十分意外。)

meaning: v. 默許；默認；勉強同意
example: The director decided to acquiesce to the committee's recommendations. (主管決定默許委員會的建議。)
The editor has a predilection for essays that connect personal stories with broader political changes. (這位編輯偏愛能將個人故事與更廣泛政治變化連結起來的文章。)
The museum invited a literary luminary to discuss censorship with writers and independent publishers. (博物館邀請一位文壇名人與作家及獨立出版社討論審查制度。)
Philosophers debate whether people act of their own volition or are shaped by their surroundings. (哲學家爭論人是依自己的意志行動，還是受環境塑造。)
The new surveillance policy may contravene privacy protections written into the state constitution. (新的監控政策可能違反州憲法明文保障的隱私權。)
The remoteness of the island complicated emergency evacuations when the storm damaged its only harbor. (島嶼位置偏遠，風暴又損壞唯一港口，使緊急撤離更加困難。)
Repeated insults seemed designed to goad the union leader into abandoning negotiations before the deadline. (一再辱罵似乎是要刺激工會領袖在期限前放棄談判。)
The documentary avoids sentimentality by showing how the family rebuilt its business after the factory closure. (這部紀錄片呈現一家人在工廠關閉後如何重建事業，避免流於多愁善感。)
Interviews challenged the preconception that older residents opposed every change to the downtown district. (訪談打破了年長居民反對市中心所有改變的成見。)
The contract includes a clause for the eventuality that severe flooding interrupts deliveries for more than a week. (合約列有條款，因應嚴重洪水導致配送中斷超過一週的可能情況。)
The high unpredictability of global atmospheric weather trends makes long-term crop yield forecasting inherently speculative. (全球大氣與天氣趨勢高度難以預測，使長期作物產量預測本質上帶有推測性。)
A small clique of donors shaped the proposal behind closed doors, leaving neighborhood groups out of consultations. (一小群捐款者閉門主導提案，使社區團體無法參與諮詢。)
The reporter had the audacity to ask the minister whether donors influenced the sudden change in policy. (記者大膽詢問部長，捐款者是否影響了政策的突然轉變。)

meaning: adj. 可爭辯的；有理由的

The court ruling gave finality to a dispute that had delayed the waterfront redevelopment for nearly a decade. (法院裁決為延宕近十年的海濱重建爭議定下了局面。)
Rapid software obsolescence forced the hospital to replace diagnostic systems before their expected service life ended. (軟體快速過時，迫使醫院在診斷系統預期使用年限屆滿前更換設備。)
The monarch agreed to abdicate after parliament negotiated a peaceful transfer of authority with opposition leaders. (國會與反對派領袖協商和平移交權力後，君主同意退位。)
The investigation exposed a sleazy arrangement in which inspectors accepted gifts to overlook safety violations. (調查揭露一項卑鄙安排：檢查員收受禮物，對安全違規視而不見。)
Analysts said executive hubris led the firm to dismiss early warnings about debt and shrinking demand. (分析師表示，高層的傲慢使公司輕忽了債務與需求萎縮的早期警訊。)

meaning: adj. 無可爭辯的；明確的
example: The archive provides indisputable evidence that officials received the complaint months before the public inquiry. (檔案提供無可爭辯的證據，證明官員早在公開調查數月前就收到投訴。)
The commercialism the duke championed was anathema to the Puritan sects. (公爵所提倡的商業主義，對清教徒教派來說極度令人生厭。)
The agency made promiscuous use of personal data, alarming advocates who had expected stricter safeguards. (機關不加區分地使用個人資料，令原本期待更嚴格保障的倡議者感到不安。)

meaning: adj. 難以持續的；不可持續的
example: Rising rents made the nonprofit current budget unsustainable, so its directors began seeking long-term funding. (租金上漲使非營利組織目前的預算難以持續，因此董事開始尋找長期資金。)
The witness testified that she signed the agreement under duress after officials threatened to revoke her business license. (證人作證說，官員威脅吊銷她的營業執照後，她是在脅迫下簽署協議。)
The company drew public ire when executives awarded themselves bonuses while freezing wages across the workforce. (公司高層凍結全體員工薪資，卻給自己發獎金，引發公眾憤怒。)

meaning: adj. 令人難信的；不可信的
example: The minister offered an unconvincing explanation for why the procurement records disappeared before the audit. (部長對採購紀錄為何在稽核前消失提出的解釋令人難以信服。)

meaning: adj. 群居的、社交的、愛交際的
example: Wolves are highly gregarious animals that rely on structured pack dynamics to hunt successfully. (狼是高度群居的動物，依賴有結構的狼群互動來成功狩獵。)
Reducing the safety team would do a disservice to employees who already face unpredictable conditions at the plant. (縮編安全團隊會傷害那些已在工廠面對不可預測狀況的員工。)
After reviewing the source documents, the magazine issued a retraction and apologized to the wrongly accused official. (檢視來源文件後，雜誌刊登撤回聲明，並向遭錯誤指控的官員道歉。)

meaning: n. 機會主義者；投機者
example: Critics called the candidate an opportunist after he reversed his position as soon as polling numbers shifted. (民調數字一變，候選人便改變立場，批評者因此稱他為機會主義者。)
The new director encouraged staff to challenge assumptions instead of remaining submissive during budget discussions. (新任主管鼓勵員工在預算討論時挑戰既有假設，不要一味順從。)

meaning: adj. 暴怒的；氣得發青的
example: The mayor was livid when auditors revealed that emergency funds had paid for luxury travel. (稽核人員揭露緊急基金被用來支付豪華旅遊後，市長勃然大怒。)
The mural’s evocation of the old harbor brought former dockworkers back to the exhibition. (這幅壁畫喚起舊港的記憶，吸引昔日碼頭工人回到展場。)

meaning: n. 沉默寡言；不願透露

The merciless heat overwhelmed crews repairing the levee during the longest shift. (最長班次期間，無情的酷熱壓垮了修復堤防的工人。)
The study explored the duality of a port that was both a commercial hub and a military outpost. (研究探討港口的雙重性：它既是商業樞紐，也是軍事前哨。)
The unpretentious director shared credit with field staff after the successful restoration. (復育成功後，這位樸實的主管與第一線人員分享功勞。)
The satirical weekly magazine was famous for its sharp, irreverent humor targeting high-profile political figures. (這本諷刺週刊雜誌以其針對高知名度政治人物的尖銳、不敬幽默而聞名。)
The columnist insinuated that the agency favored donors, though he offered no documentary evidence. (專欄作家暗示機關偏袒捐款者，卻沒有提出任何文件證據。)

meaning: adj. 慵懶的；無精打采的
example: The languid response from regulators frustrated residents who had documented repeated water leaks. (主管機關反應遲緩，讓記錄多次漏水的居民十分不滿。)
The new job posting should pique the interest of many qualified candidates. (新的職缺公告應能引起許多合格候選人的興趣。)

meaning: adj. 靜止的、沉寂休眠的
example: The massive volcano remained quiescent for over three centuries before suddenly erupting with explosive force. (這座巨大的火山在突然以爆炸性力量噴發之前，曾保持沉寂休眠了三個多世紀。)

meaning: adj. 鬼鬼祟祟的；偷偷摸摸的

The director belittled junior staff in public, prompting several experienced analysts to resign. (主管公開貶低資淺員工，導致幾位資深分析師辭職。)

meaning: adj. 極度悲慘的；卑屈的

Laughter and mirth returned to the neighborhood after the community hall reopened. (社區活動中心重新開放後，歡笑與愉悅回到了街坊之間。)
The belligerent minister threatened retaliation before mediators could present their proposal to both delegations. (調停人還沒向雙方代表團提出方案，好戰的部長便威脅要報復。)
The investigation managed to absolve the pilot from any blame. (調查免除了飛行員的所有責任。)
The consultant proposed an outlandish forecast that assumed every vacant storefront would reopen immediately. (顧問提出荒誕的預測，假設每間空店面都會立刻重新營業。)
No untoward incidents occurred while inspectors evacuated the residents from the unstable tower. (檢查人員疏散危樓居民期間，沒有發生任何不測事件。)

meaning: adj. 謹慎的；一絲不苟的
example: The accountant was scrupulous in keeping track of all expenditures. (這位會計師在記錄所有開支時都一絲不苟。)

meaning: adj. 曲折的；複雜難懂的
example: The company’s tortuous ownership structure made it difficult to identify the true beneficiaries. (公司曲折複雜的所有權結構，使人難以找出真正受益者。)
The contract includes one legal nicety that determines when suppliers may demand final payment. (合約有一項法律細節，攸關供應商何時能要求最後付款。)

meaning: adj. 反覆無常的；任性的
example: Capricious enforcement left shop owners unsure whether the new licensing rules applied to them. (執法反覆無常，使店家不確定新的許可規定是否適用於自己。)
The judge excluded extraneous testimony that distracted jurors from the central evidence. (法官排除無關證詞，以免陪審員被帶離核心證據。)
The professor's lengthy digression about his personal vacation confused students during the physics lecture. (在物理課上，教授關於他個人度假的冗長離題讓學生們感到困惑。)
At the zenith of its influence, the union represented nearly every dockworker along the coast. (在影響力的頂峰，這個工會代表了沿岸幾乎所有碼頭工人。)
Economists observed a gradual diminution of consumer spending following the implementation of the sales tax. (經濟學家觀察到，在實施營業稅後，消費者支出逐漸減少。)
Several directors demurred when the chair proposed selling the company’s most profitable division. (主席提議出售公司獲利最高的部門時，有幾位董事表示反對。)

meaning: n. 虛張聲勢；大聲威嚇
example: The minister’s bluster could not conceal how little leverage the government retained in negotiations. (部長虛張聲勢，仍掩蓋不了政府在談判中所剩無幾的籌碼。)
The columnist urged temperance in public spending rather than indiscriminate cuts to essential services. (專欄作家呼籲節制公共支出，而非不加區別地削減必要服務。)

meaning: adj. 堅定的；忠誠的；不動搖的
example: The manager remained steadfast in her determination to enforce safety protocols. (經理執行安全規範的決心依然堅定。)

meaning: adj. 腐蝕性的、侵蝕性的
example: Industrial wastewater often contains highly corrosive chemical agents that degrade concrete drainage systems. (工業廢水通常含有高度腐蝕性的化學物質，會侵蝕混凝土排水系統。)
The journalist condemned the officials’ cowardice in refusing to confront the armed militia. (記者譴責官員懦弱，拒絕正面對抗武裝民兵。)

meaning: adj. 二分的；截然對立的
example: The report rejected a dichotomous account that portrayed rural voters as uniformly hostile to reform. (報告否定了二分法的說法，指出鄉村選民並非一律反對改革。)
The inquiry focused on corruption and immorality among officials entrusted with public housing contracts. (調查聚焦於受託處理公共住宅合約的官員是否貪腐及道德敗壞。)
Strict human rights advocates completely abhor any form of institutionalized torture or illegal detention. (嚴格的人權倡導者完全憎恨任何形式的體制化酷刑或非法拘留。)

meaning: adj. 俗豔刺眼的；過分鮮豔的
example: The developer installed garish lighting that overwhelmed the historic facade at night. (開發商裝設俗豔刺眼的燈光，夜間完全蓋過歷史建築立面。)

meaning: adj. 喧嚷的；大聲疾呼的
example: Vociferous residents demanded that the council publish water test results before approving construction. (居民大聲疾呼，要求議會先公布水質檢測結果再核准施工。)
Long periods of introspection helped him understand why he had left teaching. (長時間的內省幫助他理解自己為何離開教職。)
The high thermal fluidity of subsurface molten magma dictates the eruption velocity of active basaltic volcanic fault lines. (地表下熔融岩漿的高熱流動性，決定了活躍玄武岩火山裂隙的噴發速度。)
During a field visit, the engineer had an epiphany about why the flood barrier repeatedly failed. (實地勘查時，工程師突然領悟洪水屏障為何一再失效。)

meaning: n. 龐然大物；勢不可擋的力量
example: The regional retailer became a juggernaut after acquiring rivals and standardizing its supply chain. (這家區域零售商收購競爭對手並統一供應鏈後，成為龐然大物。)
Residents reacted with incredulity when officials claimed the contaminated wells posed no risk. (官員宣稱受污染的水井沒有風險時，居民難以置信。)
A rare concord between labor and management allowed the plant to reopen safely. (勞資雙方難得達成一致，讓工廠得以安全重新開工。)
The agency released the test results to assuage public fears about the nearby chemical plant. (機關公布檢測結果，以緩和民眾對附近化學工廠的恐懼。)

meaning: adj. 乏味的、散文的、平凡的
example: The technical report was written in a prosaic style, focusing strictly on data metrics without any narrative flourish. (這份技術報告是以平淡乏味的風格寫成的，嚴格聚焦於資料指標而沒有任何敘事修飾。)

meaning: adj. 無恥的；恬不知恥的
example: The shameless contractor billed taxpayers twice for repairs already covered by the insurance settlement. (無恥的承包商，就已由保險理賠支付的修繕工程向納稅人重複請款。)

meaning: adj. 容易受騙的；輕信的
example: The fraudster targeted gullible investors with promises of guaranteed returns and secret access. (詐騙者以保證獲利和秘密管道為誘餌，鎖定容易受騙的投資人。)
The agency’s insensitivity to local customs damaged trust among families displaced by the project. (機關漠視地方習俗，損害了受計畫影響而搬遷家庭的信任。)

meaning: adj. 不得體的；不合宜的
example: An unseemly argument broke out between executives during the public memorial for the workers. (主管們在公開追思勞工的場合爆發不得體的爭吵。)
The company’s formulaic apology failed to address the specific harms suffered by affected communities. (公司公式化的道歉，沒有回應受影響社區實際遭受的傷害。)
The city was in the throes of reconstruction when another powerful storm destroyed the eastern bridge. (城市正處於重建的陣痛期，另一場強烈風暴又摧毀了東側橋梁。)
The elderly patients suffered the indignity of being left in wet clothes for hours. (這些年長病患被丟著穿濕衣服好幾個小時，毫無尊嚴。)

meaning: adj. 不顯眼的；不張揚的
example: The hotel's unobtrusive service made guests feel comfortable rather than constantly watched. (飯店不張揚的服務讓客人感到舒適，而不是一直被盯著。)
The foundation’s benevolence funded legal aid for tenants facing sudden eviction in the city. (基金會的善意資助市內面臨突然驅逐的房客取得法律協助。)

meaning: adj. 不動聲色的；冷漠的
example: The impassive negotiator listened while both delegations described years of mounting losses. (兩方代表說明多年來不斷增加的損失時，談判代表始終不動聲色。)

meaning: adj. 莊嚴高貴的；王者風範的
example: The elder stateswoman retained a regal composure throughout the televised corruption hearing. (這位資深女政治家在電視轉播的貪腐聽證會上，始終保持莊嚴風範。)
The archivist showed remarkable fortitude while rebuilding the collection after the basement flooded. (地下室淹水後，檔案管理員展現出非凡的堅毅，重建館藏。)
The historian’s restrained account gave the victims’ testimony greater pathos than any dramatic reenactment. (歷史學家克制的敘述，比任何戲劇化重演都更能呈現受害者證詞的感染力。)
The judge imposed a merciful sentence after the defendant returned the stolen funds and cooperated fully. (被告歸還贓款並充分配合後，法官從寬量刑。)
The chair interposed a procedural question before the committee approved the contested contract. (委員會核准爭議合約前，主席插入一項程序問題。)
An adversarial review process exposed weaknesses that the agency’s internal team had overlooked. (對抗式審查揭露了機關內部團隊忽略的缺失。)

meaning: n. 特有習性；獨特之處
example: One idiosyncrasy of the old port authority was its refusal to accept electronic invoices. (這個舊港務機關有個獨特習性：拒收電子發票。)

meaning: adj. 固執的；頑固的；難以去除的
example: The obstinate child refused to listen. (那個固執的孩子拒絕聽話。)
The concealment of repair records prompted residents to demand a new safety inspection. (維修紀錄遭到隱瞞，促使居民要求重新進行安全檢查。)

meaning: adj. 不合時宜的；時代錯置的
example: The anachronistic rule barred women from a profession that had long since opened its ranks. (這項不合時宜的規定，禁止女性進入早已開放的專業領域。)

meaning: n. 機會主義；見風轉舵
example: Critics viewed the sudden policy reversal as opportunism rather than a genuine response to evidence. (批評者認為，這次突然轉向是機會主義，而非真正根據證據調整政策。)
The review found a clear contravention of privacy rules in the firm’s customer tracking system. (審查發現這家公司的客戶追蹤系統明顯違反隱私規範。)

meaning: adj. 愛評判的；帶偏見的
example: Supervisors should avoid being overly judgmental when evaluating new interns. (主管在評估新實習生時應避免過度評判。)
The chair berated the contractor for ignoring repeated warnings about structural weaknesses. (主席痛斥承包商無視多次提出的結構缺陷警告。)

meaning: adj. 不體諒的；無同情心的
example: The unsympathetic response from officials deepened distrust among families seeking compensation after the fire. (火災後，官員缺乏體諒的回應加深了尋求補償家庭的不信任。)
A professional customer service agent knows how to deliver a tactful response. (專業的客戶服務代理知道如何提供巧妙的答案。)

meaning: adj. 無關緊要的；不重要的
example: The oversight seemed inconsequential until auditors found that it altered the final payment calculation. (這項疏漏原本看似無關緊要，直到稽核人員發現它改變了最終付款金額。)
Counsel adduced shipping logs to show that the disputed cargo had reached the harbor. (律師提出航運紀錄，證明有爭議的貨物曾運抵港口。)

meaning: adj. 違反直覺的；反常理的
example: The counterintuitive finding showed that reducing traffic lanes improved average travel times. (這項違反直覺的發現顯示，減少車道反而改善了平均行車時間。)

meaning: adj. 粗俗的；愚蠢無禮的
example: The executive’s crass joke about layoffs angered workers who feared losing their livelihoods. (主管拿裁員開低俗玩笑，激怒了擔心失去生計的員工。)
The poet's writing style became increasingly introspective following his prolonged isolation in the mountains. (在山中長期隱居後，這位詩人的寫作風格變得越來越內省。)
The scientist achieved global eminence due to her groundbreaking research in gene-editing methodologies. (這位科學家因基因編輯方法上的開創性研究而享有全球聲望。)
An undertone of resentment persisted beneath the executives’ carefully rehearsed statements during the negotiations. (主管們字斟句酌的發言底下，在談判期間仍暗藏著怨懟情緒。)

In legal parlance, the disputed payment could qualify as a benefit rather than a routine fee. (以法律用語來說，這筆爭議款項可能屬於利益，而非例行費用。)

meaning: adj. 奄奄一息的；停滯衰敗的
example: The moribund newspaper survived after a nonprofit acquired its archives and rebuilt its digital subscriber base. (這家奄奄一息的報紙在非營利組織收購檔案並重建數位訂戶群後存活下來。)

meaning: n. 屈尊俯就；傲慢態度
example: Residents rejected the official's condescension and demanded direct answers about the contaminated land. (居民不接受官員傲慢的態度，要求直接回答受污染土地的問題。)
The chair's frankness about the project's failures helped restore credibility with skeptical residents. (主席坦率承認計畫失敗，有助於重拾懷疑居民的信任。)

meaning: adj. 簡短生硬的；唐突的
example: The minister gave a curt reply when reporters asked whether the contract had been reviewed independently. (記者詢問合約是否經獨立審查時，部長給了生硬簡短的答覆。)
Critics said the campaign debased public debate by replacing policy arguments with personal attacks. (批評者表示，競選活動以人身攻擊取代政策論證，貶低了公共辯論。)
A spiteful leak targeted the whistleblower's family after the regulator opened an investigation. (主管機關啟動調查後，一則惡意外洩訊息將矛頭指向吹哨者家人。)
The board's dictatorial governance style discouraged executives from reporting risks to outside directors. (董事會專橫的治理風格，使主管不敢向外部董事通報風險。)
A misinterpretation of the treaty's limits led officials to approve permits the agreement prohibited. (官員誤解條約限制，核准了協議明文禁止的許可。)
The supposed consultation proved a ruse to delay public opposition until construction contracts were signed. (所謂的諮詢證明只是騙局，目的是拖到工程合約簽訂後才面對公眾反對。)
The leaked emails brought dishonor to a firm that had marketed itself as an ethical industry leader. (外洩郵件使這家自稱產業道德領導者的公司蒙上恥辱。)

meaning: vt. 反覆灌輸；諄諄教導
example: The ethics program sought to inculcate habits of disclosure before conflicts threatened public trust. (倫理計畫希望在利益衝突威脅公信力前，反覆灌輸揭露習慣。)
The statute delimits the regulator's authority, preventing it from setting unrelated industry policy. (法規界定主管機關的權限，避免它制定與監管無關的產業政策。)

meaning: n. 組織混亂；缺乏條理
example: Chronic disorganization in the relief agency delayed deliveries and obscured responsibility for missing supplies. (救援機關長期組織混亂，延誤物資運送，也讓短缺責任不明。)

meaning: n. 荒唐歪曲；拙劣仿作
example: The inquiry called the rushed hearing a travesty of due process because key witnesses were excluded. (調查稱倉促的聽證會是對正當程序的荒唐歪曲，因為關鍵證人遭排除。)
The minister offered no intimation that the disputed policy would be withdrawn before the election. (部長沒有暗示這項爭議政策會在選舉前撤回。)

meaning: adj. 未證實的；未證明的
example: The speculative hypothesis regarding prehistoric physical tools remains largely unproven. (關於史前實體工具的推測性假設，在很大程度上仍未獲證實。)
Stony chondrite meteorites offer geochemists pristine samples of the building blocks of the primeval solar system. (石質球粒隕石為地球化學家提供了太陽系原始組成物質的純淨樣本。)
In geometry class, students proved that the two triangles were congruent. (在幾何課上，學生證明這兩個三角形全等。)

meaning: adj. 值得稱讚的；可嘉的
example: The corporation's proactive pledge to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2030 is highly laudable. (該企業積極承諾在2030年實現淨零碳排放，這項舉措非常值得稱讚。)

meaning: adj. 不加批判的；不加審查的
example: Linguistic theorists warn that an uncritical acceptance of anecdotal folk accounts can distort prehistory migration chronologies. (語言學理論家警告，不加批判地接受口述民間記載，可能扭曲史前遷徙的年代序列。)
The critic accused the museum of snobbery for dismissing popular art without examining its social influence. (評論家指控博物館勢利，不願檢視通俗藝術的社會影響就予以否定。)
The foundation's credo emphasized public service, though its investment decisions often contradicted that principle. (基金會的信條強調公共服務，但其投資決策往往與此原則矛盾。)
The minister's surprise offer was a political gambit designed to divide the opposition before the vote. (部長突然提出的提議，是一項意在表決前分化反對派的政治策略。)
The board was cognizant of the environmental risks but approved the expansion without additional review. (董事會明知環境風險，仍未進一步審查便核准擴建。)
After years of travail, the coastal town secured federal funds to rebuild its storm-damaged harbor. (歷經多年辛勞，沿海城鎮終於取得聯邦經費重建遭風暴損壞的港口。)
The transit strike was an outgrowth of years of stalled wage talks and worsening working conditions. (大眾運輸罷工是多年薪資協商停滯、工作環境惡化所造成的結果。)
Officials accused the broadcaster of using fabricated reports to foment unrest before the regional election. (官員指控這家電視台利用捏造報導，在地方選舉前煽動動亂。)
The contemplative essay weighs the moral costs of development against the immediate benefits of new jobs. (這篇沉思性的文章權衡開發的道德代價與新增工作機會的立即效益。)
The new director announced the restructuring with panache, though employees remained uncertain about layoffs. (新任主管氣派十足地宣布重整計畫，但員工仍不確定是否會裁員。)
The island community achieved food sufficiency by developing sustainable aquaponics and vertical agriculture. (島上社區透過發展永續魚菜共生與垂直農業，達成糧食自給。)
Many residents venerate the judge for defending civil liberties during the years of emergency rule. (許多居民尊崇這位法官，因為他在緊急統治期間捍衛公民自由。)
The injunction sought to squelch public criticism by restricting demonstrations outside the company's headquarters. (禁制令限制公司總部外的示威活動，意在壓制公眾批評。)
The report questioned the rightness of relocating residents without giving them a meaningful role in planning. (報告質疑，未讓居民實質參與規劃就遷移他們是否正當。)
Conciliation efforts failed when the company refused to reinstate workers dismissed for organizing a union. (公司拒絕讓因籌組工會遭解雇的員工復職，調解因而失敗。)

meaning: adj. 缺乏支持的；無證據的
example: The court dismissed the unsupported claim that the permits had been issued without proper environmental review. (法院駁回了毫無證據的主張，即許可是在未妥善環評下核發。)
Political tumult followed the disclosure that senior officials had concealed the full cost of the infrastructure project. (高階官員隱瞞基礎建設計畫完整成本後，政局陷入騷動。)
The minister's trite assurances did little to address residents' detailed questions about flood protection. (部長老套的保證，無法回應居民對防洪措施提出的具體問題。)

meaning: adj. 不受拘束的；毫無顧忌的
example: The chair encouraged uninhibited debate, asking participants to challenge assumptions behind the proposed transit plan. (主席鼓勵大家毫無顧忌地辯論，要求與會者挑戰大眾運輸計畫背後的假設。)
The regulator faced a quandary: protect consumers immediately or wait for stronger evidence of misconduct. (主管機關陷入兩難：立即保護消費者，或等待更充分的不當行為證據。)
The minister's ascetic lifestyle became a political asset during debate over public spending cuts. (公共支出削減辯論期間，部長苦行般的生活方式反而成了政治資產。)
The festival's gaiety briefly lifted public spirits after months of economic uncertainty and layoffs. (經歷數月經濟不確定與裁員後，節慶的歡樂短暫提振了民眾心情。)
The imperious executive dismissed staff concerns and pressed ahead with a costly reorganization. (專橫的主管不理會員工疑慮，逕自推動昂貴的組織重整。)
The elitist art critic cast a scornful eye over the amateur painter's landscape canvas. (這位菁英主義藝術評論家輕蔑地打量業餘畫家的風景畫。)

meaning: adj. 離題的；間接相關的
example: The witness's tangential remarks obscured the central question of who authorized the surveillance program. (證人離題的發言模糊了核心問題：究竟是誰授權監控計畫。)

meaning: n. 時代錯置；過時事物
example: The report called the paper permit system an anachronism in an economy increasingly dependent on digital records. (報告稱紙本許可制度在愈來愈依賴數位紀錄的經濟中已是時代錯置。)

meaning: adj. 漫不經心的；輕率的
example: A cavalier approach to maintenance left aging water pipes vulnerable to repeated breaks. (對維護漫不經心，使老舊水管容易一再破裂。)
The magician used clever artifice to deceive the audience. (魔術師利用巧妙的詭計來欺騙觀眾。)

meaning: adj. 尖刻的；惡言相向的
example: Acrimonious negotiations over the port concession delayed investment and strained relations between the two governments. (港口特許經營權的尖刻談判延誤投資，也使兩國關係緊張。)
The pension system stood on a fiscal precipice after decades of contributions failed to match promised benefits. (數十年提撥金額趕不上承諾給付後，年金制度已站在財政懸崖邊。)
The journalist's valor in documenting abuses brought international attention to the remote detention site. (記者勇敢記錄虐待情形，使偏遠拘留所受到國際關注。)
One diplomatic misstep threatened to undo months of quiet progress on the border agreement. (一次外交失誤，差點抵銷邊境協議數月來低調取得的進展。)
A disequilibrium between housing supply and demand pushed rents beyond what local workers could afford. (住宅供需失衡，使租金超出當地工作者的負擔能力。)
The regulator said the disputed advertising practices fell outside its purview and referred the matter elsewhere. (主管機關表示，爭議廣告手法不在其權限範圍內，因此將案件轉交他處。)
The judge stressed the irrelevance of political donations to whether the contract had been legally awarded. (法官強調，政治獻金與合約是否依法授予無關。)
The program operated under the aegis of an international agency, giving local officials technical support. (這項計畫在國際機構庇護下運作，為地方官員提供技術支援。)
The report avoided pejorative labels and described the informal workers' conditions with specific evidence. (報告避免使用貶義標籤，改以具體證據描述非正式工作者的處境。)
The palace's magnificence contrasted with nearby neighborhoods where residents lacked reliable electricity. (宮殿的壯麗與附近居民缺乏穩定電力的社區形成對比。)
Politicians demonized environmental groups instead of addressing their evidence about contaminated drinking water. (政客沒有回應飲用水遭污染的證據，反而妖魔化環保團體。)
Despite sharp disagreements, the hearing maintained decorum and allowed every witness to finish speaking. (儘管意見尖銳分歧，聽證會仍維持得體秩序，讓每位證人完整發言。)
The contractor transgressed safety regulations by keeping workers inside the building during the chemical leak. (承包商在化學品外洩期間仍讓工人留在建築內，違反安全規定。)
Residents exulted when the court blocked construction on land promised for a public waterfront park. (法院阻止在承諾興建海濱公園的土地上施工，居民歡欣鼓舞。)
The auditor's financial acuity revealed irregular patterns that routine checks had failed to detect. (稽核人員敏銳的財務判斷，發現例行檢查未能察覺的異常模式。)
A costly product recall chastened executives who had dismissed early reports of equipment failures. (昂貴的產品召回讓主管受挫，他們先前曾忽視設備故障通報。)

meaning: adj. 無法壓抑的；難以遏止的
example: Her irrepressible optimism helped sustain volunteers through months of rebuilding after the storm. (她無法壓抑的樂觀，支撐志工在風災後數月的重建工作。)

meaning: adj. 無限的；無邊無際的
example: The documentary celebrates the boundless creativity of artists working with discarded industrial materials. (紀錄片讚頌藝術家運用廢棄工業材料所展現的無限創意。)
The cooperative was once a paragon of transparency, but recent contracts have raised doubts. (這家合作社曾是透明治理的典範，但近期合約引發了疑慮。)

meaning: adj. 受吹捧的；被誇耀的
example: The vaunted efficiency of the new system disappeared when outages disrupted service across the region. (停機事故影響全區服務後，新系統備受吹捧的效率便蕩然無存。)
The proposal drew vehement opposition from coastal communities concerned about fishing access and erosion. (沿海社區擔心捕魚權益與海岸侵蝕，對提案提出激烈反對。)

meaning: adj. 透露內情的；跡象的；洩密的
example: The dark mineral coloration layers of desert varnish offer a telltale signature tracking centuries of oxide deposition. (沙漠漆中的深色礦物層，是判讀數百年氧化物沉積過程的重要線索。)
The erudite historian connected archival evidence to debates about memory and national identity. (這位博學的歷史學家將檔案證據連結到記憶與國家認同的辯論。)
The editorial warned that political fanaticism can make compromise appear equivalent to betrayal. (社論警告，政治狂熱可能讓人把妥協視同背叛。)

meaning: adj. 頑強的；不屈的；堅硬的
example: The team's unyielding defence frustrated opponents throughout the entire match, especially those who had expected an easy victory. (這支球隊頑強的防守讓對手整場比賽都很受挫，尤其是原本以為能輕鬆獲勝的隊伍。)

meaning: adj. 講究的；挑剔的；營養苛求的
example: A fastidious marine algal species can thrive only in waters with specific nutrient conditions. (一種對營養條件要求嚴格的海藻，只能在特定水域中繁殖生長。)

meaning: n. 長篇激烈抨擊；痛罵
example: The executive launched a tirade against auditors after their report documented unexplained transfers. (稽核報告記錄不明轉帳後，主管對稽核人員發表長篇激烈抨擊。)
The program produced demonstrable gains in vaccination rates across districts with limited clinic access. (在診所不易取得的行政區，這項計畫明顯提高了疫苗接種率。)

meaning: n. 重新評估；重新檢討
example: A reappraisal of the port expansion found that promised employment gains had been overstated. (重新評估港口擴建案後，發現承諾的就業成長被誇大了。)
Public perplexity grew when officials revised the evacuation map without explaining the underlying risk assessment. (官員修改疏散地圖卻未說明風險評估依據，民眾愈發困惑。)
Infantile memory development operates differently, causing adults to lack long-term memories of their early years. (嬰兒期的記憶發展運作模式不同，導致成年人缺乏對其早年生活的長期記憶。)
Unclear ownership continued to bedevil the cleanup effort long after the polluted factory had closed. (受污染工廠關閉多年後，權責不清仍持續困擾清理工作。)
The lobbyist tried to ingratiate himself with officials through lavish dinners and favorable media coverage. (遊說人士試圖以盛宴和有利報導討好官員。)
The editorial opened with an aphorism about power, then examined how secrecy weakens democratic oversight. (社論以權力格言開篇，接著探討保密如何削弱民主監督。)

meaning: adj. 燦爛的；華麗耀眼的
example: The restored theater looked resplendent, though maintenance costs threatened its continued operation. (修復後的劇院華麗耀眼，但維護成本威脅它繼續營運。)

meaning: adj. 面無表情的；冷面幽默的
example: The spokesperson delivered a deadpan denial even as documents showed the agency had tracked the journalists. (即使文件顯示機關曾追蹤記者，發言人仍面無表情地否認。)
The valley's agricultural fecundity supported dense settlements long before modern transport connected it to markets. (現代運輸連結市場以前，山谷豐饒的農業已支撐密集聚落。)
The caterpillar has a voracious appetite, consuming several times its body weight in leaves daily during development. (毛毛蟲食量驚人，發育期間每天會吃下相當於自身體重數倍的葉片。)
The inspector received commendation for exposing the safety failures despite pressure from senior managers. (稽查員不顧高階主管壓力揭露安全失誤，因此獲得表揚。)

meaning: adj. 陰鬱的；愁眉不展的
example: A morose atmosphere settled over the newsroom after management announced another round of layoffs. (管理階層宣布再裁員一波後，編輯室籠罩著陰鬱氣氛。)
Finding a pristine non-flowering gymnosperm fossil inside a Cretaceous strata tier functions as an empirical counterexample. (在白堊紀地層內發現一個具原始狀態的無花裸子植物化石，充當了一個經驗上的反例。)
The team’s performance during the championship was absolutely abysmal. (球隊在冠軍賽中的表現簡直糟透了。)
Calling the levy a user fee is a misnomer when residents cannot opt out of paying it. (居民無法選擇不繳時，把這筆稅費稱為使用者付費並不恰當。)
The budget vote became a litmus test of whether the coalition would prioritize rural services. (預算表決成了試金石，檢驗聯盟是否重視鄉村服務。)
The commission propounded a new funding formula that weighted population growth and infrastructure decay. (委員會提出新的經費公式，將人口成長與基礎建設老化納入權重。)
Early steam-powered agricultural machinery was exceptionally ponderous, consuming prodigious wood volumes to complete minor work. (早期蒸汽動力的農業機械異常笨重，消耗巨大數量的木材僅能完成微不足道的工作。)

meaning: adj. 不可行的；行不通的
example: The proposed timetable proved unworkable because contractors could not obtain permits before winter. (承包商無法在冬季前取得許可，擬議時程因此不可行。)

meaning: adj. 報復心重的；懷恨的
example: A vengeful campaign against the whistleblower risked deterring future reports of financial misconduct. (針對吹哨者的報復行動，可能使人不敢再通報財務不當行為。)
A plaintive appeal from displaced families challenged officials' claims that relocation had been voluntary. (流離失所家庭悲切的陳情，挑戰了官員所稱遷移出於自願的說法。)

meaning: adj. 間接感受的；代替體驗的
example: Readers gained vicarious access to rural clinics through the doctor's detailed dispatches. (讀者透過醫師詳盡的報導，間接了解鄉村診所的情況。)

meaning: adj. 易受影響的；容易受感動的
example: The investigation examined how impressionable recruits were drawn into the fraudulent investment network. (調查檢視容易受影響的新人如何被捲入詐欺投資網絡。)
Residents described powerlessness as agencies debated responsibility while contaminated water continued flowing. (污染水持續流出之際，機關互相推諉責任，居民感到無能為力。)

meaning: adj. 糟糕透頂的；可憎的
example: The inspector described abominable sanitation at the market, where vendors lacked clean water and waste collection. (稽查員形容市場衛生糟糕透頂，攤商缺乏乾淨用水與垃圾清運。)
